text:
He is the supreme object of worship for all people.
He is endowed with great merit.
The Blessed One replied:
"Monks, ninety-one eons ago,
there appeared in the world a perfectly awakened buddha named Vipaśyin, who was learned and virtuous,
a blissful one,
a knower of the world,
a charioteer who guides beings,
an unsurpassed being,
a teacher of gods and humans, a buddha, a blessed one.
He resided in the palace of King Bandhumant.
At that time, a certain man named So-and-so, from the family of a painter,
He built a temple for Vipaśyin,
and planted many fruit trees.
The temple was fragrant with the scent of flowers.
After making these offerings, he went forth in the teachings of the Teacher.
After the parinirvāṇa of the perfectly awakened Vipaśyin, a pillar of jewels was erected at the base of his stūpa.
The many followers of the monk who was born into the family of temple builders also rejoiced and took faith.
“Just as you have faith in the Teacher, I too have faith and devotion.
I will do as the Teacher commands and please him, not displease him.
